nodes.label: Guest mode (local, free, walletless, Web Crypto seed)
On-chain vs local NEF checksum attestation
Aim Master Vite HTML entry (#app + src/main.tsx)
Burn verb semantics (GAS redistributed, not destroyed)
Guest-only release (no Curve Arrow contract configured)
Typography-Free Launcher Banner
nodes.rationale: The launcher cover-crops the hero image, so a banner with the baked-in 'Curve Arrow' wordmark ghosted through the real HTML headline as fragments ('e Arrow' / 't. Split the gold.' on desktop, a stray 'W' on mobile). The replacement carries no typography because the shell owns the words.

nodes.label: generate-banner.mjs Banner Generator
nodes.rationale: Programmatic vector art pipeline: layered SVG compositions rasterized with sharp at 2x and downscaled to webp, so no third-party asset packs enter the repository.

nodes.label: Shared CoinArt GAS Token
nodes.rationale: Canonical GAS artwork lives once in apps/shared/art; the MiniApp deliberately does not draw its own GAS logo so the token mark stays identical across the catalog.

nodes.label: Production Confirmation Rules
nodes.rationale: Eight rules pinning every read/write to canonical contract, GAS contract, network and actor; eligibility comes from contract reads rather than local calendar arithmetic; broadcast creates a durable pending operation, not success; FAULT is terminal while lagging evidence stays recoverable; failed authoritative reads are never replaced by trusted zero values.

nodes.label: Dependency-Light Shared Open UI Adapters
nodes.rationale: Swapping the drawer onto the shared Open UI adapters cut its UI JavaScript chunk from 185.21 kB to 31.74 kB while keeping the rendered design-system contract unchanged; React, UI, platform SDK and crypto are split into separate vendor chunks.

nodes.label: Streak Plaza Ritual Surface
nodes.rationale: The first screen is a sunlit plaza with a seven-day chapter, live UTC window and one context-sensitive primary action instead of a contract-parameter form; history, reward-pool detail and confirmation evidence are demoted to secondary drawers.

nodes.label: MiniAppDailyCheckin Contract
nodes.rationale: Same script hash 0x25db219a701a2b23130788723fcf9a2e76857235 and NEF checksum 170189676 on both Neo N3 mainnet and testnet; the app rejects launch-network, wallet-network, configured-contract, GAS-contract or pending-actor mismatch before confirming a write.

nodes.label: Memo-Bound GAS Check-in Transfer
nodes.rationale: There is no separate checkIn method: a direct-wallet GAS transfer of the current fee carrying the exact memo 'miniapp-dailycheckin:checkin' IS the check-in, which keeps the write surface to one primitive transfer.

nodes.label: Transaction Truth Rule
nodes.rationale: A wallet prompt, broadcast response or transaction ID is pending, not success. Confirmation requires both the exact domain event and the exact GAS Transfer event plus authoritative chain readback; neither source alone suffices. Failed or malformed reads never become fake zero streaks or 'not checked in'.

nodes.label: UTC Streak Reset Rule
nodes.rationale: Consecutive UTC days advance the streak; a missed UTC day restarts the next check-in at day 1 while preserving historical best. The boundary is read from the contract so the frontend never guesses from a local calendar date.

nodes.label: MiniAppDiceGameV2 Contract
nodes.rationale: Bound on mainnet and testnet at 0xef1fac0247ccbad5810e3fcfa1a0885d44efde39 exposing commit, settle, withdraw, bankroll, freeBankroll, reservedBankroll, creditOf, pendingBetCount and getPendingBet. A Neo X deployment at 0xFA795F814d38F218153d21838360096f3F5cb774 proves code presence only, not ABI, VRF callback, request binding or settlement semantics.

nodes.label: Dice NEF Checksum / ABI Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Deployed NEF checksum is 1347753558 on both networks while the reviewed local build is 4151519179 and adds an update method absent from the deployed ABI. The public contract answers compatible reads but is not the byte-for-byte audited artifact, so a prior signed testnet flow proves nothing about the current build.

nodes.label: Dice Game Guest-Only Boundary
nodes.rationale: The MiniApp exposes no payment permission or wallet-funded operation while the checksum gap is open; local animation and local randomness are practice play that never produce a chain-verified result.

nodes.label: Dice GameFi Activation Gate
nodes.rationale: Six-step reopening checklist: deploy the reviewed artifact, match checksum and ABI, re-run read-only bankroll/exposure/pending checks, run one authorized deposit -> commit -> three-block beacon -> settle -> getPendingBet -> withdraw flow, verify payout arithmetic and terminal state, then update source and host manifests together.

nodes.label: Flappy Bird Art Sprite Set (CC0)
nodes.rationale: CC0-1.0 sprites give Flappy Dash a real arcade playfield (day background, scrolling ground, bird flap frames, separate top/bottom pipes) rather than primitive shapes.

nodes.label: officialGasTokenPhaserUrl Shared GAS Asset
nodes.rationale: The Phaser wager marker and any GameFi reward token load the shared official GAS asset through officialGasTokenPhaserUrl; FogPlay ships no locally drawn NEO or GAS logo.

nodes.label: minigame-everyday Reference-Only Boundary
nodes.rationale: IcedSoul/minigame-everyday has no coin-flip implementation in its six-game snapshot and no clear root license file, so its code and assets stay reference-only and nothing is copied from it.

nodes.label: MiniAppCoinFlipV2 Contract
nodes.rationale: Standalone commit/reveal contract at 0x611c3d97dd98792a3c31a0e695704c657f143cda; bet range 0.05-100 GAS additionally capped by freeBankroll/2 so the house can always cover a 2x payout.

nodes.label: Fixed Three-Block Native Beacon
nodes.rationale: Deriving the result from three block hashes after commit closes the old same-transaction abort-on-loss exploit and raises grinding cost versus a single-block source. It is deliberately a low-stakes mechanism, not VRF-grade randomness.

nodes.label: commit / settle / withdraw Flow
nodes.rationale: commit(player, choice, amount) escrows prepaid GAS and reserves house exposure; anyone may call settle(betId) once the beacon window clears; unused prepaid credit returns via withdraw(account). Permissionless settlement means a stuck player never loses escrow to an offline operator.

nodes.label: getPendingBet Readback Validation
nodes.rationale: Win/loss is applied only after exact getPendingBet readback validates id, player, choice, wager, terminal state, outcome, win predicate and payout. A Settled event or transaction broadcast never confirms a result on its own.

nodes.label: FogPlay Production Safety Boundary
nodes.rationale: supportsGameFi, payment/randomness permissions, host operations and the runtime paid-lane flag are all disabled together so a wrong network, stale host or old contract cannot open a wallet prompt for a new wager, while existing pending bets keep their reveal/withdraw recovery paths.

nodes.label: Phaser 3 Coin-Flip Table
nodes.rationale: The playable surface is a Phaser 3 table, not a transaction form: authored heads/tails artwork, animated pedestal, launch/flip/land motion, sound cues and an in-game recovery drawer carry the primary flow.

nodes.label: FogPlay Local Guest Mode
nodes.rationale: Local play needs no wallet, GAS, oracle or chain call and uses browser Web Crypto for randomness; it is practice play that never produces or confirms a GameFi result.

nodes.label: FogPlay Checksum / ABI Compatibility Gap
nodes.rationale: Both public deployments report NEF checksum 2385475183 while the reviewed local artifact is 4009970425 and adds update and getOwner. The July 10 signed testnet flow validated the older deployed snapshot, so FogPlay publishes guest mode only until the gap closes.

nodes.label: Matter.js Fruit-Merge Physics
nodes.rationale: Real Matter.js simulation rather than scripted animation: fruit fall under gravity, collide and stack, and two touching fruit of the same kind merge. Only the five smallest kinds are ever dropped so the chain must be earned.

nodes.label: Eleven-Tier Fruit Evolution Chain
nodes.rationale: Cherry through watermelon scoring ladder; two watermelons merge and clear for a bonus, giving the top tier an exit instead of a permanent board blocker.

nodes.label: Board as Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The board, not the physics scene, is authoritative and checkpoints locally, so a refresh restores the exact pile in a paused state without charging hidden background time. Malformed or unavailable local storage is rejected safely and replaced with a fresh run.

nodes.label: Fruit Funnel Guest-Only Boundary
nodes.rationale: The game runs entirely local and explicitly forces guest mode, exposing no wallet, payment, reward, oracle, randomness permission, contract operation, transaction or GameFi settlement state until a real contract path is deployed and verified end to end.

nodes.label: Danger-Line Game Over Rule
nodes.rationale: The run ends only when stacked fruit comes to rest above the top danger line past a short grace period, so a transient bounce through the line is not a loss.

nodes.label: Fruit Funnel Asset Provenance
nodes.rationale: The reference repository IcedSoul/minigame-everyday (commit 73bb72fa) declares MIT in its README but ships no LICENSE file at the audited commit, so it was used only to study drop-and-merge behavior and funnel geometry; no source, screenshot, Canvas architecture or artwork was copied.

nodes.label: build-art-assets.mjs Art Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Runtime webp/avif derivatives are reproducible from their generated sources via scripts/build-art-assets.mjs and FRUIT_FUNNEL_GENERATED_DIR, so shipped art can always be rebuilt from provenance-tracked originals.

nodes.label: MiniAppGame2048 Contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0x7511eefa066820a440db5f94d9cbc1d711a598f9 at manifest 3.0.0 with live NEF checksum 1503512825 matching the reviewed local build; live config mirrors the client's three entry amounts, rewards, timers, target exponents, three-undo cap, 30% paid-lane undo penalty and 10-minute settlement grace.

nodes.label: Morpheus Oracle
nodes.rationale: Oracle at 0x4b882e94ed766807c4fd728768f972e13008ad52 with Oracle and Edge health reported ready; it supplies the TEE move/finalization callback path the paid lane would depend on.

nodes.label: Rejection-Sampled Web Crypto Spawns
nodes.rationale: Local tile spawns use rejection-sampled Web Crypto randomness and the game refuses to start when secure randomness is unavailable, rather than silently degrading to Math.random.

nodes.label: 2048 GameFi Release Gate
nodes.rationale: supportsGameFi stays false and the public manifests expose no wallet operation, transaction permission, Oracle or TEE claim because the deployed pool is empty and a paid start could not be honored. Re-enable only after funding plus a real wallet -> start -> TEE moves -> finalization callback -> credit withdrawal run against this exact checksum.

nodes.label: Three-Undo Persisted Local Board
nodes.rationale: Active board, timer, undo count, best tile and recent run history persist on device and recover after reload; withdrawal never treats a wallet broadcast as final, keeping the exact game id until a terminal contract readback or a matching CreditWithdrawn event.

nodes.label: 2048 Building Sprite Family (building-e1..e12)
nodes.rationale: The Merge Kingdom GPT-generated asset family is reused as a distinct 2048 city-upgrade skin so the board reads as real objects, while the classic numeric tile values stay visible and authoritative.

nodes.label: Removed tile-e* Sprites
nodes.rationale: tile-e1..e12 were deleted together with the unmounted React PlayArea.tsx that was their only referencer; the source sheet is retained outside the repo instead of shipping dead art.

nodes.label: 2048 Phaser Play Surface
nodes.rationale: The Phaser scene is the single play surface; the retired React PlayArea was not a second game.

nodes.label: generate-banner.mjs Deterministic Banner Generator
nodes.rationale: Original vector art (SVG -> sharp -> webp/avif, deterministic seed) replaces a legacy marketing banner that baked in its own typography and a near-black logo card. The replacement carries no lettering, keeps a calm centre band, and holds the prize-wheel motif right-of-centre where the scrim has faded.

nodes.label: MiniAppHomeShell Full-Bleed Banner Scrim
nodes.rationale: The platform shell paints the app banner full-bleed behind the live headline under only a soft white scrim, so any baked-in copy ghosts through the real title — worst on mobile where the hero crops to the centre ~26% of the artwork. This host behaviour dictates what app banner art may contain.

nodes.label: officialGasTokenPhaserUrl Shared GAS Token Asset
nodes.rationale: Every visible GAS mark loads from the shared official token asset; the app ships no hand-drawn GAS or NEO logo.

nodes.label: minigame-everyday Reference-Only Exclusion
nodes.rationale: IcedSoul/minigame-everyday lacks per-resource license evidence (README claims MIT but the snapshot has no root license file), so no code or art is copied from it across the minigame apps; it stays reference-only.

nodes.label: MiniAppRedEnvelope Legacy Contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0xfa1b7240fead2a63999c02defa3aec5eb274a919 and mainnet 0x5f371cc50116bb13d79554d96ccdd6e246cd5d59 expose standalone red-envelope methods only; neither exposes the RangeGasPool or direct-credit ABI this app consumes, so both were removed from the active manifest contracts map.

nodes.label: PlatformSocial RangeGasPool Artifact
nodes.rationale: Local contracts/build/PlatformSocial.nef (checksum 1654231107) has the required RangeGasPool and credit methods but is not the artifact deployed at either published address, so no ABI or bytecode compatibility proof exists for a paid lane.

nodes.label: Same-Transaction Runtime.GetRandom Draw
nodes.rationale: Drawing inside the claim transaction with Runtime.GetRandom is not a proof-carrying flow and stays vulnerable to selective abort/retry across blocks.

nodes.label: Oracle VRF / Request-Settle Randomness Requirement
nodes.rationale: Same-transaction randomness must be replaced by an Oracle VRF or a non-cancellable request/settle protocol that produces a verifiable result after commitment.

nodes.label: OneGate Server-Claim Lane
nodes.rationale: Disabled: its payout log verifier checks GAS/Transfer, recipient, amount, HALT and return value but does not bind the transfer source to the campaign reward source or an authorised signer — a documented 44.26874529 GAS self-transfer (from == to) was accepted as a payout.

nodes.label: Gas Lucky Pool Stakes-Free Guest Phaser Lane
nodes.rationale: Guest draws use Web Crypto only and fail closed when secure randomness is unavailable; independent local-play, OneGate server-claim and RangePool flags stop one lane implicitly enabling another, and a local animation or submitted transaction never confirms a payout.

nodes.label: Gas Lucky Pool Paid-Lane Activation Gate
nodes.rationale: Ten ordered conditions (v2 deploy + exact hash/NEF/ABI binding, verifiable randomness, durable intent persistence, application-log HALT/FAULT discrimination, exact event and canonical readback, idempotency keys, authorised testnet sequence, OneGate payout-source binding, legacy liability migration) must all pass before source, runtime, manifest, payments and transaction capability are re-enabled together.

nodes.label: Expired Red-Envelope Liabilities
nodes.rationale: Testnet holds 238 expired envelopes with 13.69904177 GAS and mainnet 10 with 0.67196114 GAS; both contracts are unpaused with a zero automation anchor and no public refund/reclaim or direct-credit withdrawal path, so the balances must be migrated or settled rather than reused.

nodes.label: GasBox Capsule Machine & Prize Capsule Cutouts
nodes.rationale: Project-owned artwork present by commit 488fa04ec with SHA-256 fingerprints recorded; the frontend copies no external game art, generates no CSS illustrations and uses no emoji as product artwork.

nodes.label: Deployed MiniAppGasBoxV2 Binding 0x30e9d4a4
nodes.rationale: Same hash on MainNet (contract id 610) and TestNet (7356), update counter 0, lastMachineId/lastBetId/pendingBetCount all 0. Zero machines is a valid live empty state; the frontend does not fabricate samples.

nodes.label: GasBox ABI Compatibility Gate Evidence
nodes.rationale: The observed ABI (commit, settle, withdraw, withdrawPool, playCreditOf, pendingBetCount, getMachine, getItem) has no update method, and its deployed manifest extra describes settle-block Runtime.GetRandom — matching the pre-fixed-beacon revision. The live contract therefore cannot be upgraded in place and is the evidence backing the frontend compatibility gate.

nodes.label: GasBox Paid-Write Gate
nodes.rationale: Because the live hash is not the local fixed-beacon artifact, the app permits read-only browsing plus necessary recovery (settle of an existing pending bet, unused-credit withdrawal, revenue withdrawal, free-bankroll withdrawal, deactivation) while blocking every new economic exposure until a new deployment is verified and registry/manifest hashes are updated.

nodes.label: Network/Contract/Wallet-Scoped Pending Reveal Journal
nodes.rationale: Scoping the journal by network + contract + wallet lets a page reload restore Reveal without resubmitting the wager.

nodes.label: GasBox
nodes.rationale: A resource-led Neo N3 capsule game in browse-and-recovery mode: real transaction state drives motion, with no fake pull timer or simulated prize.

nodes.label: MiniAppGasBoxV2 Contract
nodes.rationale: Pays fungible NEO or GAS prizes only; no NFTs, machine trading, VRF, keeper settlement or AA session keys.

nodes.label: Fixed commitIndex+1 Beacon Commit/Reveal
nodes.rationale: Binding the reveal to the fixed next-block hash makes settlement permissionless and payable exactly once, unlike the older live version whose settle-block Runtime.GetRandom re-rolls on a later settle attempt.

nodes.label: GasBox Creator Contract Flow
nodes.rationale: createMachine, addItem (1-based weighted rows), memo-bound NEP-17 pool funding, setActive gated on free pool covering the largest prize, withdrawRevenue, and withdrawPool which returns only unreserved bankroll.

nodes.label: Decimal-String Base-Unit Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: All amount comparisons and writes use decimal-string base units so display numbers are derived from exact values rather than float-rounded ones.

nodes.label: Gomoku Original Vector Art Assets
nodes.rationale: Board, stones, last-move ring, win glow, result seal and difficulty badges are original to the repository — layered SVG rasterized with sharp at 2x then downscaled to webp, with no third-party asset packs.

nodes.label: Jump Rush
nodes.rationale: Published lane is the free local Phaser 3 game: supportsGameFi is false, the public operation list is empty, and the runtime forces stale non-guest launches back to guest mode before any wallet or chain operation can start.

nodes.label: PhaserPlayArea Single Play Surface
nodes.rationale: PlayArea.tsx is only a compatibility alias to PhaserPlayArea.tsx so the retired DOM/CSS prototype cannot be mistaken for a second game.

nodes.label: Jump Rush TestNet Contract 0xd98c65af
nodes.rationale: Kept in the manifest for maintenance and recovery only; the app neither advertises nor starts paid games against it.

nodes.label: Morpheus Wrapper / Contract Rule Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Contract and wrapper do not describe the same game: jump targets 10/20/30 vs 15/25/35, limits 60/90/120s vs 180/300/480s, minimum solve 15/30/45s vs 20/40/60s, three penalized undos vs zero, and the enclave route generator wraps its 32-byte stream after 16 width/gap pairs so long routes repeat.

nodes.label: Web Crypto Rejection-Sampled Route Generation
nodes.rationale: Local play builds the route with Web Crypto and rejection sampling, never falling back to Math.random or repeating a 32-byte seed pattern.

nodes.label: Validated Namespaced Run Recovery Storage
nodes.rationale: An unfinished run is restored only after its route, counters, timing and undo state pass validation; expired or malformed data is discarded, and storage or leaderboard failures never block gameplay.

nodes.label: Jump Rush GameFi Activation Gate
nodes.rationale: GameFi must not be enabled by changing the manifest alone: first align wrapper, contract and UI rules, prove the bind and settlement digest byte layouts, decide whether undo stays in the paid game, expose history fields explicitly, then run the full wallet/testnet recovery matrix before operations, payments, TEE permissions and supportsGameFi flip together.

nodes.label: Deployed Solved Event (seven fields)
nodes.rationale: The deployed event publishes neither jumps nor perfects, so the frontend reads only the seven available fields and leaves the perfect count explicitly unknown rather than inferring it.

nodes.label: Kenney Jumper Pack CC0 Sprites
nodes.rationale: Gameplay sprites (bunny poses, carrot, clouds, grass platforms) come from Kenney's Jumper Pack under CC0 1.0 Universal; the app banner and logo are project compositions derived from the same CC0 artwork.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Arena Artwork
nodes.rationale: last-survivor-arena.webp is the Phaser arena background; survivor-scene-art.webp was removed with the unmounted React PlayArea.tsx that was its only referencer.

nodes.label: scripts/generate-scene-art.mjs
nodes.rationale: Supports GPT Image plus a fallback provider, but historical raster assets carry no run metadata proving which provider produced them; if distribution requires provider-level provenance the art must be regenerated and its model, prompt, date and hashes recorded.

nodes.label: Canonical Binding and Durable Recovery Journal
nodes.rationale: Every write is bound to exact wallet, launch network, contract, action, amount and round before the wallet opens; recovery storage must pass a write/read/delete round trip before broadcast, and the pending record is held in session memory before the durable write so a storage failure cannot turn a broadcast into an apparent invitation to submit again.

nodes.label: Transaction Outcome Reader (HALT / FAULT / indexing delay)
nodes.rationale: Success requires the expected event from the bound contract plus an authoritative readback; indexing delay, HALT-with-missing-event and proven VM FAULT are each distinguished and none is converted into success.

nodes.label: Unavailable-vs-Zero Read Distinction
nodes.rationale: Unavailable round, quote, credit, key, history and wallet-balance reads are kept distinct from authoritative zero values; a failed wallet GAS read shows as unavailable, never as a confirmed 0.00 GAS.

nodes.label: Last Survivor
nodes.rationale: A bright Phaser 3 last-seat duel: local rivals steal the lead on an unpredictable rhythm, players trade safer large key packs against higher-scoring small packs, and must still hold the final seat when the countdown reaches zero.

nodes.label: MiniAppLastSurvivor Contract
nodes.rationale: TestNet 0xff122a6cf7f22a88d059d61a9d9c07e84a2b56b9 is the verified v1.1 pull-payment generation; MainNet 0x8e1e432e966357de8d7642564b744d3274a81bd0 is v1.0 with a different NEF, so no MainNet write is treated as equivalent.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Public ABI (buyKeys / settle / withdraw)
nodes.rationale: Reads getCurrentRound/getRound, currentKeyCost/keyCost, playerKeys and creditOf; writes buyKeys, settle and withdraw.

nodes.label: Permissionless Pull-Payment Settlement
nodes.rationale: Settlement is permissionless and credits the winner rather than pushing GAS during settle, so a hostile or failing recipient cannot block round rollover. The game deliberately uses no oracle or off-chain randomness.

nodes.label: Arithmetic Key-Price Curve
nodes.rationale: Base key price 10,000,000 base units with a 10,000 base-unit increment per key; each key extends the clock 30s, remaining time caps at 86,400s, and a single transaction buys at most 1,000 keys.

nodes.label: Last Survivor 中文说明 (Chinese README)
TestNet NEF Checksum Match Evidence
nodes.rationale: Local and live NEF checksums both 2859468900 with SHA-256 1d1a2ea8c05cbf05cf3994a9053768703409c036b75990ab47971e64f5cb43e1, plus HALT read probes and a passing two-wallet buy/expiry/settle/withdraw harness.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Paid Activation Matrix
nodes.rationale: The contract is proven but activation still needs one current end-to-end wallet/browser run against this exact build: connect without accidental buy, atomic shortfall transfer + buyKeys, exact KeysBought recovery across refresh and rollover, duplicate-submit lock during indexer lag, expiry + permissionless settle, winner withdraw readback, failure/reconnect recovery, and desktop plus mobile presentation. These stay explicit evidence rather than inferred success.

nodes.label: MiniAppMergeKingdom Contract 0x3fa9eb98
nodes.rationale: Deployed NEF checksum 4260724675 matches the local build exactly, and deployed getConfig values match the frontend's 0.02/0.10/0.20 GAS entry tiers, 0.10/0.50/1.00 GAS rewards, 3/5/10 minute limits, 30/60/120s minimum solve times and 64/256/1024 targets.

nodes.label: Morpheus Oracle 0x4b882e94
nodes.rationale: isAllowedCallback(mergeKingdom) is false and the contract's fee credit is 0 against a 1,000,000 base-unit request fee, so no oracle-backed settlement can complete yet.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom Guest Phaser Lane
nodes.rationale: Phaser 3 resource-driven local merge game with Web Crypto spawn selection using unbiased rejection sampling, device-local board recovery, and no wallet, payment, oracle request or chain write in guest mode.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom Activation Checklist
nodes.rationale: Checksum match, config match and a playable guest game are done; funding a reward pool covering every advertised tier, allowlisting the callback in Morpheus, funding the request-fee credit and running start/replay/finalize/expiry/withdrawal on testnet remain open before GameFi manifests may be enabled.

nodes.label: Empty freePool / reservedPool State
nodes.rationale: freePool, reservedPool and lastGameId are all 0, so the published app keeps supportsGameFi false, exposes no paid operation and makes no reward claim while retaining the historical GameFi implementation for readback, settlement recovery, expiry release and credit withdrawal.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom GPT-Generated Tile Sprites
nodes.rationale: Generated for the July 2026 miniapp visual refresh (reference 019e7e7b-66c2-7c11-9e25-a0679675bbec) to replace number-only tiles with real merge-game objects.

nodes.label: On-Chain Tarot Miniapp
nodes.rationale: App ID miniapp-onchaintarot. Phaser 3 three-card tarot ritual published as a local guest-only reading; the catalog manifest deliberately omits contract operations, payment permission, and randomness permission so no unverified on-chain path is presented as production-ready.

nodes.label: Guest-Only Release Policy
nodes.rationale: GameFi stays disabled because neither live testnet deployment matches the production promise: the legacy oracle contract is incompatible with the ReadingDrawn client flow, and the standalone contract uses same-transaction Runtime.GetRandom rather than oracle VRF. Shipping a disabled entry is preferred over advertising an unverified chain path.

nodes.label: Web Crypto Rejection-Sampling Randomness
nodes.rationale: Guest card draws use Web Crypto with rejection sampling and explicitly refuse a Math.random() fallback, so local randomness is unbiased and non-predictable even without a chain source.

nodes.label: 链上塔罗牌 (Chinese On-Chain Tarot README)
MiniAppOnChainTarot legacy oracle contract
nodes.rationale: Neo N3 testnet 0x5cdf29c30727ce06696736ae0fb49abd9fd79730; exposes requestReading/initiateReading/settleReading/getReading/onOracleResult. Historically bound to the catalog and .miniapp.neo domain but does not expose the deposit + draw + ReadingDrawn ABI the current client needs.

nodes.label: MiniAppTarot standalone deposit/draw contract
nodes.rationale: Neo N3 testnet 0xb680225a1be276b03ecd7de82ea985dcc7435cec; onNEP17Payment/draw/withdraw/getReading/creditOf with Credited, ReadingDrawn, CreditWithdrawn events. Authoritative on chain but settles with Runtime.GetRandom inside the draw transaction, which is not an oracle/VRF result.

nodes.label: MiniAppTarotVrf VRF replacement contract
nodes.rationale: Compiled and contract-tested but not deployed. Flow: reusable GAS credit -> requestReading(player,maxOracleFee) -> Morpheus callback -> terminal getReading. Failure/timeout restores the full reading fee, refundExpiredReading is permissionless, withdrawAllCredit returns unused credit, and only playerCompletedReadingCount feeds HUD counters. NEF 940ad17df103c834db9224de38235496ce19d154b56b16c690ec8fd9f0fe36da.

nodes.label: Morpheus request/callback settlement flow
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous settlement pattern: the client persists a pending reading and shows real sealed card backs while waiting, refreshes from getReading, and surfaces timeout recovery as the primary action rather than treating request submission as a drawn spread.

nodes.label: On-Chain Tarot GameFi activation checklist
nodes.rationale: supportsGameFi may flip only after: RPC-verified deployment hash; registry, manifest, host catalog and .miniapp.neo domain resolving to that same hash; request bound to the connected player and a unique request id; settlement restricted to an authenticated oracle callback writing three unique card indices; client success gated on verified === true plus contract readback; and live timeout/cancel/refund plus unused-credit withdrawal tests. Mainnet stays disabled until the gate passes independently.

nodes.label: On Chain Tarot Vite HTML shell
On-Chain Tarot card art provenance
nodes.rationale: Card fronts composite third-party Rider-Waite-Smith scans onto an original Neo Tarot frame; each scan is cropped to drop the title strip and scan border and color-matched into one dark jade / antique-gold deck finish. The card back is fully original artwork. Local filenames and source URLs are recorded in index.json.

nodes.label: Pet Potion Miniapp
nodes.rationale: Complete free local Phaser 3 pet-care and potion game. Feed/play/pet/rest drive satiety, energy, happiness, evolution and recipe essences; a win needs the target happiness, all four essences, an explicit brew, and settlement inside the 40-action and route-time limits. Nursery, timer, difficulty, history, stats, recipe and brewed state auto-save and recover after reload.

nodes.label: MiniAppPetPotion contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0xa611f038371f49b6e46c992e9aa95f53d6ac2b38, manifest 3.0.0, update counter 0, live NEF checksum 900775675 matching the locally reviewed build, network magic 894710606. Live config mirrors the client entry/reward values, 3/5/10-minute timers, 30/60/120-second minimum solve times, 50/70/100 happiness targets, three-undo cap, 30% paid-lane undo penalty and 10-minute settlement grace.

nodes.label: Morpheus Oracle 0x4b882e94ed766807c4fd728768f972e13008ad52
nodes.rationale: Shared Morpheus Oracle contract configured on the Pet Potion deployment. Oracle and Edge health report ready, request fee 0.01 GAS, but the callback allowlist is false and the app holds 0 GAS oracle fee credit, so no paid run can settle.

nodes.label: Pet Potion GameFi release gate
nodes.rationale: supportsGameFi stays false and the public manifests expose no wallet operation, transaction permission, Oracle or TEE claim, because a paid run cannot work with an empty pool, a non-allowlisted callback contract and no oracle fee credit. New paid starts have an independent code-level kill switch, historical paid-run recovery stays in the runtime, and unknown settlement is never rendered as a win.

nodes.label: Pet Potion art provenance
nodes.rationale: All Pet Potion art was generated for this project with OpenAI image generation from a retained source sheet under generated_images/019e7e7b-66c2-7c11-9e25-a0679675bbec.

nodes.label: IcedSoul/minigame-everyday gameplay reference
nodes.rationale: day-01-screw at commit 73bb72fa6b144148fc7c7e93c83ffd47f3d9f173. Its README claims MIT but the audited checkout has no root LICENSE and no per-asset provenance, so no upstream image, font, bundled Phaser file, binary asset or source file was copied; only the core interaction was studied.

nodes.label: Screw Sort original visual assets
nodes.rationale: Workshop, plank, screw, toolbox, overflow tray, logo and banner were generated with OpenAI image generation on 2026-07-10, then resized, alpha-cleaned, composited and encoded to WebP/AVIF. The ~13 MB of high-resolution PNG sources are deliberately not committed to a repo that will hold dozens of games; only ImageGen batch and output identifiers are retained.

nodes.label: Screw Sort wallet-free runtime boundary
nodes.rationale: Version 1.1.0 performs no Neo RPC, contract, oracle, balance or wallet read and no chain or payment write; wallet connection is never requested and GameFi rewards are neither enabled nor simulated. default_network in neo-manifest.json is platform catalog metadata only, so the runtime must stay fully playable offline. An optional practice leaderboard is off-chain and its failure never changes the authoritative local win.

nodes.label: Screw Sort release boundary
nodes.rationale: supportsGameFi, wallet permissions, transaction capability, oracle/TEE claims, GAS copy and contract operations stay off until a deployed and funded design has its own authoritative settlement, a durable pending journal, exact event/readback verification, testnet recovery evidence and independent product review.

nodes.label: Authoritative core.revision presentation gate
nodes.rationale: A selected screw is committed immediately and visual motion starts only from the next authoritative core.revision plus the exact MoveEvent, so no fixed-duration animation preview can claim success before the pure engine agrees.

nodes.label: Storage write read-back verification
nodes.rationale: Every snapshot write is read back before recovery is promised; throwing and silent no-op storage failures keep local play working but are surfaced as unavailable rather than pretending progress was saved. Snapshots are rebuilt by replaying the compact move trace and impossible snapshots fail closed with a visible recovery message.

nodes.label: Screw Sort Miniapp
nodes.rationale: Production-oriented Phaser 3 + React-bridge puzzle for the Neo MiniApps platform, shipped as a complete local game with no wallet, GAS, contract, oracle, TEE or chain write required or advertised.

nodes.label: Sixth-unmatched-screw loss rule
nodes.rationale: Five overflow sockets are safe and only the sixth unmatched screw loses the run. This deliberately corrects the upstream reference implementation, whose label claimed a full five-slot tray loses while its code actually failed on the sixth click.

nodes.label: Three-phase deterministic solvability
nodes.rationale: Levels are built in three constructive phases with four distinct active colors per phase and a lane color change between phases; lower screws declare explicit upper-board blockers and a replayable solutionOrder clears the phases. Unit tests replay 2,000 deterministic seeds per run, and persistence is validated by replaying the stored move trace from a clean level rather than trusting JSON shape.

nodes.label: 螺丝工坊 (Chinese Screw Sort README)
day-01-screw reference audit
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the upstream rules retained (four color cases, three screws per case, five-slot overflow, higher boards blocking lower screws, case rotation pulling matching overflow screws) and seven defects deliberately not migrated: a blank web entry, the mislabelled overflow loss, no solvability proof, post-tween screw reservation allowing double-tap overfill, a single screw render layer breaking occlusion, a 720x1280 surface producing tiny touch targets, and missing recovery/pause/undo/reduced-motion.

nodes.label: @r3e-network/neo-miniapp-shared SDK
nodes.rationale: The shared MiniApp runtime that once lived in apps/shared is now published from the neo-miniapp-sdk repository; the @shared/* alias resolves into node_modules. All new shared code belongs in the SDK repo, not this directory.

nodes.label: apps/shared traversal placeholder
nodes.rationale: The directory is kept intentionally non-empty because several tests reach sibling apps via apps/shared/../<slug>/..., a path the OS only resolves when every segment exists; deleting the directory made those reads fail with ENOENT despite the target file being present.

nodes.label: Sheep Solitaire asset provenance
nodes.rationale: All visible art was generated for the July 2026 miniapp visual refresh from a coordinated tile/mascot/badge/tray/meadow source sheet. IcedSoul/minigame-everyday is used only as a gameplay mechanism reference because its asset licensing is not explicit enough for reuse. Lucide React is limited to interface icons; gameplay pieces are raster resources, never emoji or CSS drawings.

nodes.label: Sheep Solitaire Miniapp
nodes.rationale: Published path is a Phaser 3 layered tile board with 15 project-owned tiles, a seven-slot tray, three constructively solvable routes, exact device-local recovery across refresh, corrupt-state rejection, pointer/touch/keyboard/screen-reader controls, and Web Crypto generation with no Math.random downgrade. No wallet, payment, oracle, TEE or chain write ships in guest mode.

nodes.label: MiniAppSheepSolitaire contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0x7541e13629eb35ec54181be2772bff34e39d3c35, manifest v2.0.0, update counter 0, live and local NEF checksum 3040306411, network magic 894710606, TEE signer 02911ea28aee939ef686f42e1137954135998b71e7e997794bde8c0a40f4b95cb4. Live config matches the frontend mirror (entries 0.02/0.10/0.20 GAS, rewards 0.10/0.50/1.00 GAS, 5/8/12-minute limits, 8/12/15 tile types, three layers, three undos, 30% undo penalty, 10-minute grace) but freePool is 0 so no advertised reward can be reserved.

nodes.label: Morpheus Sheep TEE engine
nodes.rationale: The enclave worker still distributes one copy of every symbol per layer, omits bind_signature from the session start response, returns no authoritative tray or result flags on move views, mismatches visible shuffle/remove-three semantics, and uses 30/60/90-second minimum solve windows against the contract's 60/120/180.

nodes.label: Triple-per-layer solvable layout
nodes.rationale: The guest game assigns complete triples within a layer and the shuffle tool preserves that invariant, guaranteeing solvability; the one-copy-per-layer distribution used by the enclave can force the seven-slot tray to fill before a match, which is why the paid lane cannot ship until the layout is ported.

nodes.label: Sheep Solitaire paid activation checklist
nodes.rationale: Remaining gates: port the triple-per-layer layout and exposure rules to Morpheus; return bind signature, authoritative tray, result flags and tool counts on every start/resume/move; align shuffle, remove-three, undo and minimum-solve semantics; fund a pool covering every tier; and run paid start, bind readback, op-log replay, restart recovery, finalize, exact getGame readback, timeout release/refund and withdrawal on testnet. Historical chain recovery stays implemented but fails closed when the enclave omits required fields.

nodes.label: generate-sheep-tiles.mjs asset generator
nodes.rationale: Hand-authored SVG -> sharp -> webp pipeline that emits all 15 tiles, the meadow field, wooden tray, sticker CTA, prop buttons and the die-cut mascot derived from public/logo.webp. Grass squiggles use a seeded PRNG so output stays byte-stable.

nodes.label: Sticker/papercraft art language
nodes.rationale: Flat fills, near-black outlines, hard offset shadows and zero gradients, calibrated so tiles stay readable at 40px. Concrete fixes driven by that constraint: the cream-on-cream wool ball was recolored because it read as a blank card, and the pink-dominant sheep faces were redrawn because they read as pigs. The circle-composite mascot was retired in favour of a die-cut reframe of the in-house logo, since banner extraction left no clean alpha matte.

nodes.label: Snake Bounty art provenance
nodes.rationale: Gameplay sprites are original AI-generated assets created 2026-07-04 and manually cropped into transparent PNGs. boundary-wall.jpg is a separate 2026-07-11 garden-wall illustration used purely as a lobby rule illustration - it deliberately introduces no second collision model and does not alter the Morpheus snake rules.

nodes.label: Sudoku Arena Miniapp
nodes.rationale: The production miniapp publishes the complete local Phaser 3 game only: gamePage.modes.gamefi is false, transaction/oracle/compute permissions are off, and the public operation panel is empty.

nodes.label: MiniAppSudoku contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0xd4ba00fb7297d08d563d8c281541dbb22725dad1, live NEF checksum 1847762914 matching contracts/build/MiniAppSudoku.nef, network magic 894710606. The live ABI carries the expected start/finalize/callback/expiry/withdraw/read methods, but isPaused false with poolBalance, reservedPool, freePool and lastGameId all zero means no live game has ever settled.

nodes.label: GAMEFI_NEW_ENTRIES_ENABLED kill switch
nodes.rationale: Code-level constant held false so new paid entries fail closed independently of manifest configuration, while the dormant client path keeps its strict identity/readback/pending/recovery checks for a future certified release.

nodes.label: Client/runtime engine hash binding
nodes.rationale: Engine hash 679aea4220667dec0e921eb364392f7983dae440a3aa9e43a215a4d054ab58c8 ties the deployed contract to the workspace Morpheus Sudoku wrapper source and operator registry. A matching artifact and canonical oracle reference are necessary but explicitly not sufficient production evidence without a funded pool and a completed live game.

nodes.label: Sudoku Arena Gameplay Assets
nodes.rationale: Board tiles, interaction states, pencil-note props, difficulty seals, sealed puzzle envelope, solved badge and reward trophy were generated with OpenAI image generation specifically for Neo MiniApps, then cropped/composed locally, so they are original project assets rather than third-party game media.

nodes.label: generate-art.mjs Deterministic Art Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Runtime WebP/AVIF/PNG variants and transparent per-object textures are regenerated deterministically by prebuild so a clean checkout fails loudly instead of silently depending on stale checked-in outputs.

nodes.label: generate-audio.mjs PCM Audio Synthesis
nodes.rationale: Twelve interaction cues and three ambient loops are synthesized as original PCM WAV files so no third-party or commercial-game recording enters the bundle.

nodes.label: verify-assets.mjs Release Asset Gate
nodes.rationale: Checks expected dimensions for 186 public images, requires alpha on all 162 per-object textures, validates every PCM WAV header/duration, and rejects a package/manifest version mismatch.

nodes.label: model-kit surface() Procedural Skin Pass
nodes.rationale: Each finish (produce, glaze, ceramic, metal, wood, fabric, paper, matte) gets a shared 64x64 procedural albedo/normal/roughness triple so material response comes from code rather than painted identity symbols or per-instance texture downloads.

nodes.label: 162 Gameplay Match Identities
nodes.rationale: Documentation deliberately distinguishes 162 gameplay identities from the 54 authored model/icon bases so the project never claims 162 unrelated source models.

nodes.label: Same-Silhouette Near-Match Colourway System
nodes.rationale: Variants reuse an authored base with a separate material colour, localized name, physics identity, size tier and deterministic hue treatment, keeping colourways distinguishable without painting symbols onto objects; the thumbnail generator segments the dominant body material so structural accents survive recolouring.

nodes.label: Genre-Mechanics Review Boundary
nodes.rationale: Gameplay rules may resemble a known three-match extraction genre, but brand marks, commercial character designs, commercial source code and commercial media are declared outside the project source set.

nodes.label: art-src SOURCE_MANIFEST SHA-256 Pin
nodes.rationale: ImageGen job IDs and verbatim prompts were never emitted into the workspace, so the immutable SHA-256 list is declared the canonical identity record instead of inventing unverifiable provenance.

nodes.label: Original Chibi Goose Art Direction
nodes.rationale: Three independent settings (fresh market, farm kitchen, night market), warm toy-like material language and portrait mobile backdrops, with no original-game brand marks or character copies.

nodes.label: Goose Basket Shuffle Production Readiness
nodes.rationale: Separates repository/browser automation from evidence only real iOS/Android hardware can produce; a green local build is necessary but explicitly not sufficient for mobile release approval, so the decision stays CONDITIONAL RELEASE CANDIDATE.

nodes.label: verify:release Local Release Gate
nodes.rationale: One authoritative command chains tests, ESLint, shim hygiene, balance audit, release audit, dependency audit, deterministic asset regeneration, asset gate, TypeScript, Vite build, bundle scan, gzip budgets, dist digest, dist staging and staged host parity so a release cannot be staged from a dirty or partially generated public/ tree.

nodes.label: Real-Device Release Gate
nodes.rationale: iOS motion permission, Android motion delivery, toss calibration, audio unlock/mix, haptics, frame time, memory/GPU stability, background/resume, responsive input and full three-theme flow must each be recorded on at least one current iPhone and one mid-range Android before unconditional release.

nodes.label: build:device-qa Instrumented Build
nodes.rationale: Rejects missing, placeholder or non-hex VITE_BUILD_SHA so a physical-device run cannot produce 'local-unbound' evidence, and regenerates the deterministic art/audio bank so evidence cannot come from a stale resource set.

nodes.label: device-qa:verify-suite Evidence Verifier
nodes.rationale: Runs every report with --strict-evidence-files and requires at least one accepted iOS/Safari and one accepted Android/Chrome report for the same app version and build id; the single-report verifier is only a precheck.

nodes.label: Staged Host Parity Gate
nodes.rationale: The host-served platform/host-app/public/miniapps/zhuada-e tree is replaced from the current dist/ and must match file-for-file and SHA-256-for-SHA-256, so the framing host cannot serve a drifted bundle.

nodes.label: Gzip Bundle Budget Gate
nodes.rationale: Three.js and cannon-es are split into cacheable chunks and gzip budgets cover the entry, scene, Three.js and physics chunks so CDN bundle delivery stays bounded.

nodes.label: Production Bundle Leak Scan
nodes.rationale: Rejects leaked Device QA instrumentation or playtest debug shortcuts from the production runtime while requiring them in the dist-device-qa artifact.

nodes.label: No Offline Support Policy
nodes.rationale: neo-manifest.json declares features.offlineSupport:false; there is no app-owned Service Worker or precache manifest, so incidental browser caching must not be advertised as offline support.

nodes.label: Chain-Free Local Run Policy
nodes.rationale: Level generation, physics, matching, scoring, progress and resumable-run snapshots need no chain or API; this release ships no wallet, leaderboard fetch or score submission and the drawer reports only a device-local personal record.

nodes.label: Memory/GPU Stability Evidence Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires >=20 start/retry/exit/resume cycles, one long Level 15 run, a memory timeline path, memoryTrend=flat, restartSlowdown=none and contextLossLoop=false.

nodes.label: Frame-Time Smoothness Gate
nodes.rationale: Median FPS >=55, P95 frame time <=25ms, longest foreground frame <=80ms, long-frame rate <=0.6% and worst consecutive slow-frame burst <=2 frames, because an acceptable median FPS alone hides visible hitching.

nodes.label: 24-Level Monte-Carlo Balance Audit
nodes.rationale: scripts/tune.mjs parses the level curve and mathematical triple invariants from source and audits them before release.

nodes.label: Goose Basket Shuffle Mini-Game
nodes.rationale: Production mini-game built with React, Three.js and cannon-es using an original three-match extraction rule set, three selectable art themes, local progress, optional timed play, generated sound effects and an opt-in motion pan-toss gesture.

nodes.label: Streamed Bottom Reservoir (54 to 18+27)
nodes.rationale: 18-1,584 logical items back a run while the live Cannon body ceiling stays at 54; complete-triple layers emerge from under the pile after visible excavation instead of falling from the top, which matches the reference video's near-empty-then-whole-layer rhythm.

nodes.label: Constrained Render Tier
nodes.rationale: Software renderers and low-memory four-core phones reduce antialias/shadow/raster cost without removing items, physics bodies, collisions, materials, picking, refill waves or game rules.

nodes.label: Opt-in Phone Motion Pan-Toss Gesture
nodes.rationale: Motion stays disabled until the player presses a visible Enable button, and a visible Shake button remains available when sensor access is unsupported, blocked, denied or cooling down.

nodes.label: In-Memory Motion Sample Privacy Rule
nodes.rationale: Motion samples are processed in memory inside the current page and are never persisted or uploaded.

nodes.label: Seven-Slot Tray Matching Rule
nodes.rationale: Fixed seven slots filled left to right, three-of-a-kind clears, a full tray loses; holes compact left and same-kind items group together.

nodes.label: 24-Level Curve (18-1,584 Items)
nodes.rationale: L1 randomly selects a balanced three-kind tutorial; L2 jumps immediately to 48 scene kinds and 864 logical items, with size-family and exact-silhouette guardrails keeping replays varied without a fixed opening layout.

nodes.label: Reference Implementation Compliance Record
nodes.rationale: The product goal is a close playable genre implementation, not a copy of the commercial game or an unlicensed community repository.

nodes.label: Juejin Reference Article
nodes.rationale: The fetch reached a wait/interstitial page so no source text was imported; treated as a named public learning reference only.

nodes.label: CSDN CC BY-SA Reference Article
nodes.rationale: Marked CC 4.0 BY-SA and describes a Three.js + Cannon.js loop; only uncopyrightable gameplay ideas and architecture comparison may be used, never the Vue source, textures, screenshots or prose.

nodes.label: Gitee hanshuoggg/big-goose Repository
nodes.rationale: Excluded from production reuse because the reviewed repository page does not specify a license.

nodes.label: Commercial WeChat Zhua-Da-E Game
nodes.rationale: Proprietary with no known open-source release; art, sound, logo, brand presentation, package assets and source code must not be extracted or reproduced.

nodes.label: Allowed Genre-Mechanics Reuse
nodes.rationale: Reusable: physically simulated 3D objects in an open container, item extraction, seven-slot collection, three-of-kind clearing, tray-full failure, refill streaming, shake/toss interaction, and the Three.js + rigid-body + raycast-picking architecture.

nodes.label: Reference Port Release Rule
nodes.rationale: Any future iteration that copies or ports code/assets must update this file with the precise source URL and commit/date, add license text and attribution, and rerun the release gate.

nodes.label: Reference Video Audit Baseline
nodes.rationale: A 136.6s 308x720 clip sampled at 15 timestamps is used strictly to extract pacing, spatial proportion and interaction-feedback baselines, never original art, copy, advertising, characters or commercial marks.

nodes.label: Reference UI Composition Metrics
nodes.rationale: Container occupies ~95-98% of screen width, HUD ~200px, tray/tools ~130px, fixed 7 tray cells about 40x42px each, so core play always completes within one screen.

nodes.label: Refactor Acceptance Matrix
nodes.rationale: Each row separates the video-visible baseline from the engineering threshold, explicitly stating the thresholds are project targets and not measured results from the original video.

nodes.label: Long-Level Reserve Requirement
nodes.rationale: A level may hold hundreds of logical items but only dozens of real rigid bodies at any moment, and reserve waves of complete triples must surface from the basket bottom rather than dropping in from the top of the screen.

nodes.label: Simulator QA Evidence Package
nodes.rationale: Records iOS Simulator and Android emulator evidence for fast iteration and mobile-browser regression catching, while explicitly not replacing the physical Device QA release gate.

nodes.label: Android Software-Renderer Compatibility Pile
nodes.rationale: The runtime classifies the Android Emulator OpenGL ES Translator automatically and switches to a real-asset DOM pile backed by authoritative game state; the hidden Three/Cannon loop pauses and resumes with a discarded clock delta so physics cannot jump. It proves rules, assets, layout and input only, never production WebGL, physics performance, audio, haptics or motion.

nodes.label: dist:digest Build Identity
nodes.rationale: Every simulator evidence package signs exactly one 214-file dist digest, so a geometry or asset change after the run invalidates the signature and forces a rerun.

nodes.label: Visible-Surface-First Pick Rule
nodes.rationale: Oversized invisible tap proxies could hit the ray before another item's real visible surface, so picking always prefers the nearest visible authored surface and falls back to hollow-item proxy volumes only when no real surface is hit.

nodes.label: Minimum Simulator Evidence Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires app version, dev URL, dist digest, all three theme IDs, iOS and Android screenshots, an explicit localhost bridge, WebGL canvas presence, fallback state, and a pick proof where trayCountAfter > trayCountBefore, so a static screenshot cannot pass.

nodes.label: public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt Release Copy
nodes.rationale: The shipped public asset mirrors the repository notices so the CDN-delivered bundle carries the required runtime-library attributions and ISC/MIT license text.

nodes.label: Zhuada-e Design QA Matrix
nodes.rationale: Compares the reference frame and implementation screenshots at the same viewport to check composition, density, layering, controls, material and motion continuity; final result is conditionally passed with Android physical-device WebGL still open (P0:0, P1:1, P2:0).

nodes.label: Broad-Face Rest Physics Correction
nodes.rationale: Thin cards, wedges, paper parcels and shallow trays resting on edge collapse to a rectangle from the top-down camera and read as a mismatch with their tray thumbnail, so nearly sleeping thin bodies receive a bounded angular-velocity correction rather than a quaternion write or a locked orientation; collisions and Shake can still tip them.

nodes.label: v5 Material Finish Skin Pass
nodes.rationale: v2's uniform high-intensity bump made porcelain, glaze, produce and fabric look identically grainy, so successive passes moved to finish-specific responses and per-object skin phases with warm wood/paper fibre and cool glaze/metal highlights, never painted stripes or badges.

nodes.label: Farm-Kitchen Kettle Silhouette Rebuild
nodes.rationale: The old side-view handle collapsed into a black slash from the overhead camera and the upended body read as fruit, so the kettle gained a genuine three-dimensional bail spanning X/Z and arching in Y, a curved spout, a lid field and an enamel ring that stay readable upright, on its side and mid-roll.

nodes.label: Marker-Free Identity Expression Rule
nodes.rationale: Identity is carried by silhouette, whole-body colour block, proportion and material only; slashes, crosses, rings, badges, cords, stamps and thin banding were removed from both source atlases and runtime hint feedback, which instead lifts, scales and emissively pulses the object itself.

nodes.label: 1870ms Triple-Match Tray Choreography
nodes.rationale: Ordinary slotting/grouping uses a readable 750ms beat; a triple runs 240ms highlight, 420ms clear and 460ms left-compaction, with tray movement constrained to translate3d/opacity and 3D press, flight arc, camera kick and pan-toss timings centralised in scene-motion.ts to avoid scattered magic numbers.

nodes.label: Broad Hue-Family Colour Distribution
nodes.rationale: A fixed hue offset clustered unrelated items into purple/mint and let three large same-kind bodies clump, so treatments now distribute per product family, cover at least seven hue families per deal, cap single-bucket crowding, and scatter each opening triple across three pile sectors.

nodes.label: Zhuada-e HTML App Shell
nodes.rationale: Portrait mobile shell with viewport-fit=cover and apple-mobile-web-app meta, mounting src/main.tsx into #app and pointing icon/og:image at the generated logo.png and banner.png.

nodes.label: MiniAppTarotVrf Contract
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous Neo N3 Tarot draw contract, compiled and mock-E2E tested but not deployed; it is independent from the existing MiniAppTarot deployment and must not update that contract in place.

nodes.label: Morpheus Oracle Randomness Source
nodes.rationale: 32 bytes are requested from Morpheus and the contract never falls back to Runtime.GetRandom; on network magic 894710606 a null deploy payload selects the pinned canonical TESTNET Morpheus hash, and every other network must supply an explicit Oracle Hash160 with no cross-network default.

nodes.label: onOracleResult Callback Adapter
nodes.rationale: Used only when network magic is 894710606 and the configured Oracle is the canonical TESTNET contract 0x4b882e94ed766807c4fd728768f972e13008ad52.

nodes.label: onMiniAppResult Rich Callback Adapter
nodes.rationale: Every non-canonical-TESTNET deployment commits to the eight-argument adapter so settlement can bind caller, Oracle, network, app/module/operation, requester, reading and request IDs, player index, tombstone, adapter, fees, request time and a recomputed payload hash.

nodes.label: requestReading Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Takes (player, maxOracleFee); the live Oracle request fee is read at call time and bounded by both the player's maxOracleFee and the 0.1 GAS reading fee.

nodes.label: Rejection-Sampled Partial Fisher-Yates Card Draw
nodes.rationale: Derives three distinct cards in 0..77 from 32 oracle bytes; rejection sampling avoids the modulo bias a naive reduction would introduce.

nodes.label: Player Credit and Oracle Reserve Accounting
nodes.rationale: Two separate buckets with distinct memos (miniapp-tarot-vrf:credit in exact 0.1 GAS multiples, miniapp-tarot-vrf:oracle); successful readings split the fee between earned revenue and reserve replenishment.

nodes.label: Deadline Expiry Refund Convergence
nodes.rationale: Oracle failure, malformed entropy or local expiry restores the whole reading fee to withdrawable player credit while an already-spent Oracle fee stays an operator cost; after the deadline both transaction orderings converge, since a keeper can refund first and invalidate a later callback, or a callback arriving first performs the expiry refund instead of drawing cards.

nodes.label: vrf_random Semantics Caveat
nodes.rationale: vrf_random currently means signed Morpheus CSPRNG output and is explicitly not a formal proof-carrying VRF, so integrators do not over-claim verifiability.

nodes.label: build_tarot_vrf.sh Pinned Compiler Build
nodes.rationale: Pins Neo.Compiler.CSharp 3.9.1 and checked arithmetic so contract bytecode is reproducible.

nodes.label: verify_tarot_vrf_morpheus_testnet.mjs Read-Only Verifier
nodes.rationale: Verifies TESTNET network magic, canonical Oracle hash, ABI generation, method signatures/safety flags and the current request fee without loading a WIF or building a transaction.

nodes.label: Completed-Reading Read Surface
nodes.rationale: completedReadingsCount and playerCompletedReadingCount count successful spreads only, so pending and refunded requests are never presented to a client as cards drawn.
